/deploy-pipe-connect --supraenv `supraenvironment` --notify-to `user@email.com`

### Write above the supraenvironment to deploy the connector and the user email to notify :rocket:

---

### Example

> /deploy-pipe-connect --supraenv pre --notify-to user@inditex.com
